venues.name: Space
venues.notes: Full sound system (mics, amps, speakers). All meals here. Sound checks for all bands. Hard blocks: Brunch, Dinner, sound checks.

venues.name: Asteroid
venues.notes: Biggest shala. Best for large movement classes, drum circle, dance. Away from other shalas — sound isolation good.

venues.name: Comet
venues.notes: Mid-size. Away from other shalas — sound isolation good. Good for circus, flow arts, acrobatics.

venues.name: Stardust
venues.notes: Round shape, similar size to Comet. Good for intimate circles, yoga, meditation.

venues.name: Meteor
venues.notes: Stacked above Nebula. Has roof. Close to Space — avoid loud music when Space is active. Cannot run simultaneously with Nebula if both have sound/music.

venues.name: Nebula
venues.notes: Below Meteor. Roof + wooden floor. Cannot run simultaneously with Meteor if both have sound/music. Close to Space.

venues.name: Sky
venues.notes: Biggest shala. In forest — no roof. Heavy mosquito problem: ONLY usable 9/10am–4pm. Do not schedule early morning or after 4pm.

venues.name: Crater
venues.notes: Tribal Lunch only. No other sessions scheduled here.
